name: Statsig
description: Statsig lets agents look up feature gates, dynamic configs, experiments, and metrics in a Statsig project, and draft changes that the project's review rules still apply to. Each user signs in to their own Statsig account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which feature gates have been fully rolled out for more than a month and can be cleaned up?
Summarize the results of the checkout experiment so far.
Draft a new feature gate for the beta search page that targets internal users only.

apps.name: Statsig
apps.description: Feature gate, experiment, and metric lookup and edits, over Statsig's MCP server with browser sign-in.
